name: Pooja Sharma
title: Stunning Chikankari Kurti & Pure Silk Quality
comment: The Chikankari kurti I ordered exceeded all my expectations. The fabric is pure, soft breathable cotton with exquisite hand-embroidery. Delivered within 3 days in beautiful boutique packaging. Truly premium experience!

name: Ananya Sen
title: Flawless fit on the wide-leg denim jeans
comment: Finding jeans that fit both waist and hips perfectly has always been a struggle, but Ristuti's high-rise jeans fit like a glove! Great stretch, super flattering cut, and sturdy denim weave.

name: Meera Iyer
title: Magnificent Kanjivaram Saree for Diwali
comment: Wore this saree for our family Diwali celebration and received countless compliments! The zari sheen is subtle and regal, not loud or cheap. Drapes with such grace.

name: Rhea Kapoor
title: Everyday tops that elevate your daily look
comment: I bought three different tops for work and casual outings. The satin wrap top is divine and pairs effortlessly with both skirts and trousers. Love the minimalist aesthetic.

name: Shreya Mukherjee
title: Lovely Festive Anarkali Gown
comment: Gorgeous color and flared silhouette! Felt like royalty wearing it. The inner lining is pure cotton so it didn't itch at all during the long wedding function. Super happy.

name: Tanya Varma
title: Denim shorts are comfortable & chic
comment: Great length, comfortable waistband, and premium distressed finish. It's rare to find high quality women's shorts that are both stylish and modest. 10/10!

name: Dr. Kavita Joshi
title: Exceptional customer support & swift dispatch
comment: I had a query regarding sizing and called the support number—the team was remarkably polite and helped me choose the right fit. The order arrived early in pristine condition.
